values.name: Maria Bobela
values.bio: Maria Bobela is a Polish depth freediver from Warsaw who left a career in graphic design for the sport. She discovered freediving in 2021, began competing internationally a year later, and became AIDA World Champion in Constant Weight No Fins in 2024. She holds Polish national records in Free Immersion, Constant Weight Bi-Fins and Constant No Fins, and also coaches and teaches freediving.
